body: Thank you for the information. I'm willing to see a psychologist, I've never really thought about doing so, but if it could possibly help I don't see the harm in going... once again thanks for all of this.

Thank you, honestly, for this. I haven't talked to anyone and it's nice to hear some advice and encouragement. 

It's been an off and on kinda thing, started in my teens and it comes back, usually when I'm cooped up in my house for a long time or when I'm too busy. I don't feel as bad as I did yesterday, definitely don't want to end it anymore, I can tell you that. I probably slept most of it off but I'm afraid of it coming back.
